pair.title: Set up this kiosk
pair.hint: In the admin portal, open Devices, add a self-service kiosk for this location, and type the pairing code it shows.
pair.hubUnreachable: The location hub cannot be reached. Check this device's network connection.

unavailable.title: Self-service is not available here right now
unavailable.body: Please order at the counter. Thank you!

welcome.startScan: Tap to start, or scan an item

scan.enterHint: The number under the barcode lines.

cart.title: Your order
cart.empty: Your order is empty. Tap an item to add it.
cart.unavailable: An item in your order is no longer available. Remove it to continue.

checkout.title: Check your order
checkout.name: Your name (optional)
checkout.nameHint: We call it when your order is ready.
checkout.howToPay: How would you like to pay?
checkout.terminalHint: Pay here with your card or phone
checkout.counterHint: Pay a cashier with cash or card

paying.title: Pay on the card terminal
paying.body: Tap, insert or swipe your card. Follow the terminal's instructions.
paying.declined: The payment did not go through
paying.declinedBody: Nothing was charged. Try again, or pay at the counter.

done.kitchen: We are preparing your order. Watch the screen for your number.
done.completed: Payment complete. Take your items, and have a nice day.
done.counter: Please pay at the counter and show this number.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.body: Your order will be cleared in {{seconds}} seconds.

attendant.pinHint: Enter your employee code and PIN to leave the customer screens.
attendant.title: Attendant menu
attendant.unpairBody: It forgets its credential and needs a new pairing code from the admin portal.
